summary: Limbo entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Limbo

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC at native desktop resolution

primary.why: Limbo has been widely ported, but the current PC version provides the cleanest capture route and no sourced platform-exclusive content requires a secondary run.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam Windows version at native desktop resolution. Console/mobile ports are ownership alternates unless comparing controls.

entries.remaster_caveats: GOG availability has changed over time; Steam/current platform availability should be checked before capture.
